data.name: Ramanna
data.gender_notes: Ramanna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ramanna is derived from the name Rama, which means 'God of Abundance' or 'Protector'. The suffix '-anna' means 'little' or 'young'. Thus, Ramanna can be translated as 'Little Ram'. The name Ramanna carries the meaning “Little Ram” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Ramanna usually hope their child will grow to embody little ram and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramanna is a divine name, associated with the deity Rama. It symbolizes strength, courage, and loyalty. It is believed that those named Ramanna are blessed with the qualities of Rama and are protectors and providers.
data.etymology: Ramanna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Ram.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramanna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ramanna holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is reminiscent of Lord Rama, one of the most revered deities in Hindu mythology. Lord Rama's life story, as told in the ancient Indian epic Ramayana, is an embodiment of Dharma (righteousness) and helps teach moral values. The name Ramanna pays homage to this rich heritage and spiritual sensibilities and imparts a sense of reverence and respect to the individual bearing it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ramanna symbolizes the divine presence of Lord Rama within an individual. It is believed that by invoking Lord Rama's name and qualities, one can lead a virtuous and righteous life, free from worldly attachments and desires. The name Ramanna serves as a constant reminder of the divine nature of the self and inspires one to strive for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramanna is a name derived from Rama, the embodiment of supreme love and virtue in Hinduism. The suffix 'anna' means brother, indicating the deep bond of love and brotherhood that Rama represents. It symbolizes the ideal of selfless service and devotion to the divine.
